A two-variable change of variables evaluates the universal gamma constant. Above the critical density, a geometric-ratio bound and near-consensus coupon-collector harmonic sum prove leading coefficient one. Rational Gaussian elimination for n=3..9 independently reproduces recurrence; numerical n<=200000 is merely supplemental.
